camouflage: The season the map is set in.

tips.overall: How good players think it is. Ranked on a mean shrunk towards the average of every map vote, so a map with four votes cannot outrank one with four hundred.
tips.fun: How much players enjoy being sent here, which is regularly not the same question.
tips.votes: Votes cast, every one from an account with real battles behind it.
tips.consensus: How far apart the voters sit. Sort descending for the maps players cannot agree on, which is the more interesting list.
